profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer | AI Platform & Agentic Systems
profile.summary:
I’m a Principal AI and Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and building enterprise software, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, and production AI solutions.
 
My recent work focuses on Generative AI and agentic systems, including autonomous AI agents, LLM orchestration, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Model Context Protocol (MCP), prompt engineering, structured LLM outputs, AI tool integration, multilingual AI, AI governance, and production-grade evaluation and reliability.
 
At Iyotah Solutions, I helped architect and build enterprise AI capabilities spanning AWS and Google Cloud, including an AgentCore/MCP platform that exposes governed business capabilities to AI agents, Generative AI reporting and advisory systems, automated investigation architectures, multilingual AI workflows, and integrations with BigQuery, Aurora, AWS Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, S3, and Vertex AI.
 
My background also includes extensive enterprise engineering experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Kafka, Python, REST APIs, microservices, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and distributed systems. I’ve worked on high-volume financial systems, cloud modernization initiatives, SaaS platforms, and production systems where reliability, security, scalability, and maintainability are critical.
 
Outside of my primary professional roles, I contribute to technology and AI projects involving autonomous LLM agents, AI-powered recruiting, marketplace platforms, and early-stage product development. These projects have given me additional hands-on experience with agent self-correction, human-in-the-loop workflows, structured AI decision-making, LLM testing and evaluation, privacy-aware AI systems, and technical leadership.
 
I am currently a Doctor of Science (DSc) candidate in Computer Science, with research focused on Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence in cloud-native environments.
 
Areas of focus: Agentic AI • Generative AI • LLM Systems • AWS Bedrock AgentCore • MCP • AI Agents • Prompt Engineering • AI Architecture • AI Governance • Cloud Architecture • Distributed Systems • Java • Kotlin • Python • AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer | AI Platform & Agentic Systems
positions.description:
• Architected an enterprise agentic AI platform using AWS Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling AI agents to securely discover and invoke governed business capabilities across AWS, Google Cloud, BigQuery, and Aurora.
 
• Expanded a production MCP ecosystem from 43 to 65+ typed, allowlisted business capabilities spanning reporting, analytics, herd health, feed performance, weather, and operational intelligence, backed by nearly 3,000 automated tests.
 
• Engineered MILA, a production Generative AI reporting and advisory platform integrating LLMs, structured prompting, business data, memory, multilingual generation, weather intelligence, and text-to-speech.
 
• Designed agentic investigation capabilities for automated root-cause analysis, including incident identity, recurrence detection, deterministic retry handling, and investigation decision logic.
 
• Established AI security and governance controls including least-privilege access, MCP tool allowlists, typed contracts, audit logging, schema-drift monitoring, and safeguards against unrestricted database operations.
 
• Implemented multilingual Generative AI workflows for English and Spanish with structured outputs, prompt versioning, domain terminology, and multilingual TTS.
 
• Built cross-cloud AI infrastructure integrating AWS Bedrock/AgentCore, Lambda, Aurora, CloudWatch, SNS, and S3 with Google BigQuery and Vertex services.
 
• Developed Kotlin/Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, business logic, persistence, integrations, and automated tests.
 
• Helped lead production RCA across Python, Kotlin/Spring, LLM prompts, BigQuery routines, database migrations, cloud infrastructure, and source data.

projects.title: Yeats — Agentic AI Recruiting Platform
projects.description:
Principal Engineer contributing to the architecture and development of Yeats, an AI recruiting platform built around autonomous LLM agents and human-supervised decision making.

• Designed and hardened the “Dispatcher,” an autonomous LLM agent pipeline that analyzes candidate communications and history, produces structured JSON Patch decisions, and applies validated changes through a transactionally safe production layer.

• Built a self-correcting agent loop that feeds schema, structured-output, and application errors back to the LLM for bounded retries, escalating to human review when the agent cannot safely converge.

• Developed provider-agnostic agent abstractions supporting configurable LLM selection and future multi-provider architectures.

• Built deterministic testing infrastructure for nondeterministic AI workflows, enabling end-to-end agent testing in CI without live API calls while separately validating behavior against production Claude models.

• Engineered privacy-conscious LLM observability that protects candidate PII while retaining structured diagnostic information required for agent self-correction.

• Hardened document and text extraction for HTML, PDF, and DOCX content used as LLM context.

• Validated autonomous agent behavior across recruiting workflows including resume processing, referrals, candidate outreach, spam classification, and unsubscribe requests.

• Implemented compliance-safe automation including RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe and human-review safeguards.

• Validated agent-facing changes against a 2,900+ test suite and repeated real-model evaluations.

projects.title: PuffRunner — On-Demand Delivery Technology Platform
projects.description:
Co-Founder & CTO providing technical leadership for PuffRunner, an on-demand delivery technology platform connecting customers, retailers, and delivery operations through a unified marketplace.

• Lead technical architecture, engineering strategy, and platform development across customer, retailer, delivery, and administrative experiences.

• Design scalable marketplace and delivery workflows supporting ordering, fulfillment, retailer integration, real-time operational processes, and customer experiences.

• Architect technology supporting regulated-product workflows, including age-verification and compliance requirements as core platform capabilities.

• Drive cloud, backend, API, data, security, and integration architecture with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

• Translate business and product requirements into technical architecture, implementation roadmaps, reusable platform capabilities, and engineering priorities.

• Evaluate automation, cloud, and emerging technologies that can improve marketplace operations, retailer onboarding, delivery efficiency, and platform growth.

• Provide technical leadership across architecture reviews, engineering standards, deployment strategy, security, observability, and long-term platform evolution.
